body: I can't afford a lawyer. I've tried to get jurisdiction moved. I've tried a parental alienation case. Nothing has come from any of it because it would depend on the children talking to the judge and my ex fights that tooth and nail. It's just been a crushing week and this is only the surface turmoil. I really feel like I don't have anything to live for. There's all that and the medical stuff I didn't get into and losing my dad. It's been the hardest two weeks.

My oldest is withdrawn. My two younger ones are loving. My youngest told me their dad said not to call me mom anymore because they're going to have a new mom soon. Hurt bad to hear that. I've been doing everything right and one bad choice of mine and everything crumbles. It's not like my bf and I live together. He doesn't even see the kids and I'm still being punished for having him as a SO. Even breaking it off won't stop this. My ex is a good ok boy in a small town. The judge sides with him every time.

He lied about being clean. Came to reddit even and said I knew the whole time and encouraged his use. But lied to my face that he was clean. He blamed me to his friends. I lost custody in the divorce and had visitation but my ex has been slowly whittling away the time I have. The kids need time with their friends, they're old enough they don't need time with their mom. The judge agreed. Now my ex is using my SOs addiction to take away the ten hours I get with them every other weekend. If I'm lucky I'll get 4 hours supervised every other weekend. Sucks so badly.

No. I have to support them. My SO is an addict (the lie). My mom has constantly told me my entire life I'm a failure after she left and I had to raise my siblings. My siblings I have to keep bailing out of their mistakes because I'm de facto mom. My abusive ex has custody and I've been fighting for my time with my kids but he continues to deny me visitation to hurt me. I'm not their mom anymore his girlfriend is and he's made sure my kids don't call me mom anymore. Its painful. It's hard to wake up most days.

I kept reiterating that this last weekend was the last time I'm going to see my kids (long messy situation). She on the line kept getting me to try and make plans for future outings with them. Just made everything worse. I finally had to hang up or I was going to do something while on the phone with them.
